items.title: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.excerpt: Figma explains what its node-based AI generation canvas Weave unlocks for creative teams: chaining image/video models into repeatable, reusable creative pipelines, with tips for getting the most out of it.

items.title: How to design transparent AI cost controls
items.excerpt: A practical guide to choosing usage units, designing spending limits and explaining AI costs before, during and after the work, since a quick edit and a long-running agent look identical in today's interfaces. (Date from Medium RSS pubDate; article HTML is Cloudflare-blocked.)

items.title: Context is the new interface
items.excerpt: Argues the future of interface design lies between products: AI agents reading on-screen context to interpret and chain app capabilities, replacing manual app-switching. (Date from Medium RSS pubDate.)

items.title: The people using AI should set its strategy
items.excerpt: Using a researcher who catches an AI synthesis tool inventing a quote, the piece argues practitioners who know what good output looks like should own AI tool decisions, with ops handling plumbing. (Date from Medium RSS pubDate.)

items.title: "Use their tools against them": why AI isn't the death of production design
items.excerpt: Production designer Christopher Glass shares how newcomers can use AI tools to their advantage rather than be displaced, amid layoffs and 'time-saving' tools in the creative industry.

items.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
items.excerpt: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro: instead of retrying one general-purpose editor, it picks the right specialized tool for each step. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: Anthropic updates Claude to stop it from recreating existing video games
items.excerpt: Anthropic added a rule so Claude Code refuses to clone existing video games, while still helping with original or genre games; developers report legitimate projects being blocked too.

items.title: Boris FX releases Continuum 2027
items.excerpt: The effects plugin suite adds a 3D noise generator and 2D titling tool, and updates its AI masking tools: Face ML now follows the full face shape, Matte Refine ML preserves hair detail, Witness Protection ML uses precise masks. (Date from RSS; page lacks meta.)

items.title: Wirbel um MecAgent: KI-Assistent für SolidWorks soll CAD-Dateien im Hintergrund hochgeladen haben, Anbieter reagiert
items.excerpt: A r/SolidWorks user reported the AI CAD assistant MecAgent searched for CAD files (incl. STL/STEP) in the background and uploaded them to its servers; MecAgent responded and suspended its free tier. (Off-list; date from RSS, page Cloudflare-gated.)

items.title: Allplan Max 2027 launched for engineering workflows
items.excerpt: Nemetschek's Allplan Max 2027 brings AI into BIM engineering tools: Feature Builder, Workflow Builder, AI Formula Writer, AI BIM Analyst, AI Structural Analyst, AI Drafter, AI Visualizer and more, on the Nemetschek Intelligence Platform.

items.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
items.excerpt: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic are implementing a new setting that lets websites express AI-training preferences, a new opt-out route for creators' published work.

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.excerpt: A Verge editor vibe-coded a Muse Charm-style AI companion gadget on a Waveshare ESP32 board with Claude, showing hardware prototyping via AI coding.

items.title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a 'personalized digital menu' at the drive-thru
items.excerpt: Starbucks plans AI-driven personalized digital menu boards at drive-thrus and AI in its app — a service/interface design shift. (Weak design hook.)

items.title: The Role of UX in Agentic Software Factories
items.excerpt: AI-native software development lifecycles reduce UX to 'AI context'; NN/g argues UX must discover user needs, shape what's built, and evaluate it before and after launch. (Off-list but core UX research outlet.)

items.title: 한국인 챗GPT 활용, 문서 편집 1위 유지…시각 자료 제작 1년 새 2배
items.excerpt: 국내 이용자들의 업무용 챗GPT 활용은 여전히 문서·글 편집이 1위지만, 이미지·디자인 등 시각 자료 제작 비중이 1년 사이 두 배로 늘었다. (Off-list; KST 18:16.)

items.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
items.excerpt: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models ahead of the EU AI Act's December labeling deadline; on Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 a single sampling parameter bypasses it. (Provenance/labeling; weak design hook.)

items.title: AI News: The Only 6 Stories Worth Knowing This Week
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe's weekly roundup: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra with faster computer use at lower API cost and other top AI stories of the week. (uploadDate from watch page.)
